calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) outdoor, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) web
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE p.category='Garden' AND st.store_id<>999 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(fr.refund_net) refunds
  FROM fact_return_line fr JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fr.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=fr.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=fr.return_date
  WHERE p.category='Garden' AND st.store_id<>999 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net, coalesce(r.refunds,0) refunds, s.sales_net-coalesce(r.refunds,0) net_sales, s.outdoor, s.staff, s.web FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, p.subcategory, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.quantity) u, max(f.net_amount) maxline, max(f.quantity) maxq FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND st.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
r AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(fr.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line fr JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fr.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = fr.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fr.return_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden' AND st.store_id <> 999 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) AS garden_net_sales
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY s.fiscal_period
